headline: Today being rest is the only reason the dead sync has not cost you anything yet - tomorrow it would.
body:
Sixth sync window missed in a row. training.json still reads **generated_at 2026-09-08 20:22**, now **59.6 hours** old, so Wednesday's bike and yesterday's run have no file and there has been no wellness row since Tuesday. Both are marked done, not missed. Tell me what you actually did.

Today is full rest and the wind agrees - **73 km/h gusts**, SE, every window. So the one job is waking the laptop and running the sync, because tomorrow is the session that needs it: **50 km at 140-150 bpm**, then **8 km at 6:30-6:50/km**, race kit and race breakfast.

Two unknowns for Saturday. The last HRV I saw was **53 against a 60.8 mean**, a second morning under baseline, and it is three days stale. And weather.json stops at today - no Saturday forecast at all, on gusts that ran **49, then 64, then 73** across three days.

How is the ankle? It carries the 8 km off the bike tomorrow.
